changelog: Unified executive /weathertime and /conf_acn_weathertime console with direct access to all 8 modules.
8K multi-tile interactive tactical map engine with seamless pointer drag-pan, cursor-centered wheel zoom, and instant reset.
Live interactive zone placement and polygon tracing directly on the map with real-time SVG shape and pin rendering.
Zone microclimates with customizable weather distribution percentages and quick 1-click climate presets.
Direct control decks for solar eclipses, aurora borealis, perseids meteor showers, flight turbulences, and live Doppler radar.
